topic: How customer reviews mentioning your city help you rank
caption:
Reviews that mention your city pull more weight than most owners know.

Google reads those words. 'Great service in Apple Valley' is a signal, not just a compliment.

After every job, ask your customer to mention the city when they leave a review.

One sentence from them does work your website alone cannot.
